headline: Frontline Bases Shift Amid Heavy Fighting
war_summary: On day 254 the war remains undecided, but the last three hours have sharpened the picture of the most volatile sectors. Godcrofts continues its relentless churn with 56 ownership changes in the past 24 hours, while Weathered Expanse recorded 33 flips, Stlican Shelf 30, Fishermans Row 25, Stonecradle 16 and Linn Mercy eight. Casualties on these fronts stay high: Weathered Expanse added roughly 9,600 Colonial and 13,100 Warden losses in the last day, Stlican Shelf about 3,000 Colonial and 2,800 Warden, and Stonecradle 4,200 Colonial and 5,900 Warden. Enlistments are climbing sharply on the active fronts — Weathered Expanse (+20 per hour, accelerating), Godcrofts (+2 per hour, accelerating), Stlican Shelf (+25 per hour, cooling), Stonecradle (+16 per hour, steady) and Linn Mercy (+11 per hour, steady) — while the majority of regions report no base movement and only modest casualty increments. Deadlands, Farranac Coast, Mooring County and Marban Hollow have shown limited new activity after earlier bursts. The strategic map therefore hinges on the six sectors above for any near‑term ownership swings.
